seo.title: PrintX | Bulk Document Printing & Mail Merge Solution
seo.description: PrintX is a secure, local-first web app (PWA) to automatically print bulk ID cards, certificates, and labels from spreadsheets. 100% runs in your browser.
seo.keywords: bulk document printing, mail merge, automatic certificate generator, mass ID card printing, printx, local pwa, excel to PDF
seo.og_title: PrintX | Bulk Document Printing & Mail Merge Solution
seo.og_description: Convert spreadsheet data into print-ready PDF documents in seconds. 100% secure, offline-capable, and runs directly in your browser.

hero.title: Transform Your Spreadsheets Into Print-Ready Documents
hero.subtitle: Effortless mass printing solution for everyone. Create ID cards, certificates, and labels in seconds.

problem.title: Manual Burden
problem.desc: Formatting documents manually is the old way. Copying data from spreadsheets to design software is error-prone, tedious, and hard to scale. PrintX bridges the gap between structured data and physical output seamlessly.

1.title: 1. Choose Template

3.title: 3. Export & Print
3.desc: Generate print-ready PDFs with bleed marks and cut lines in just one click.
